notes:
- Send files of any size straight to a friend. Big files no longer go through the cloud, so there's no size limit.
- If there isn't enough space on your friend's computer, VORP tells you right away instead of failing partway.
- Your computer stays awake while a transfer is running.
- Shared Claude sessions are easier to follow: you can see who's hosting, whether Claude is working, and who's in the room.
- Everyone in a shared session can message Claude, and you can invite more friends while it's running.
- A small Open button keeps your session one click away when you minimize it.
